artifacts.summary: Analysis of 5 approaches, all blocked. 3 alternatives proposed.

next_steps: Run /revise 303 to create plan v4 based on Option A (strengthen ExistPart) or Option B (VecEA2 generalization)

sorry_inventory.why_deferred: ih_exist constant-parent limitation; compositionality false on Prior structures

memory_candidates: Compositionality (1-var NF types + ordering determine 2-var NF type) is FALSE on Prior structures. Counterexample: M=(Z,<) with no predicates, env1=(0,2), env2=(0,1), k=1. Z with no predicates is a Prior structure (UZ/SZ trivially satisfied because all formulas are tautologies or contradictions).

ExistPart's signature with parent_atoms : AtomKind sig 1 -> Bool enforces constant parent env (fun _ => t). Until/Since zone quantifier conditions require non-constant parent [x,t]. Three architectural alternatives: (A) strengthen ExistPart to condition on parent NF, (B) generalize VecEA2 brackets to k>0, (C) Rabinovich negation closure.
